title: circCEP70 encoded protein inhibits the progression of hepatocellular carcinoma.
authors: Li, Lian; Xu, Liangliang; Liao, Wenwei; Wang, Peng; Xu, Mingqing; Li, Bo; Zhang, Ming
journal: Cellular and molecular life sciences : CMLS
one_liner_zh: 该文研究circCEP70编码蛋白通过PKM2/STAT3轴抑制肝癌进展，虽用AlphaFold 3分析蛋白互作，但核心是circRNA编码蛋白与PKM2的互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合体系，且无AI/物理模拟方法用于结合建模，与本课题关联度低。
abstract: Cirrhosis is closely related to hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), however, the regulation of circular RNA (circRNA) in HCC with cirrhotic background has not yet been well illustrated. In this study, high throughput circRNA sequencing was applied to identified candidate circRNAs in HCC samples with cirrhotic background. The biological function of candidate circRNA was validated in both in vitro and in vivo settings. Additionally, Alphafold 3, mass spectrometry analysis and immunofluorescence were employed to investigate the underlying mechanisms involved. We found circCEP70 exhibited significantly higher expression levels in cirrhotic HCC samples and showed a positive correlation with improved prognosis. The RNA binding protein U2AF2 was found to suppress the expression of circCEP70 in cirrhosis patients. In vitro and in vivo experiments, including CCK-8, EdU, plate cloning, transwell, scratch, subcutaneous tumor formation, liver metastasis in situ, and lung metastasis assays confirmed the anti-carcinogenic effects. Mechanistically, circCEP70 encoded a novel protein named CEP70-160aa, which interacted with PKM2 and hindered its translocation into the nucleus. This interaction led to reduce STAT3 phosphorylation in the nucleus, thus inhibiting HCC proliferation and metastasis. In cirrhotic microenvironment, circCEP70 prevented HCC proliferation and metastasis through PKM2/STAT3 axis, and RNA binding protein U2AF2 could inhibit circCEP70 expression.
abstract_zh: 肝硬化与肝细胞癌（HCC）密切相关，然而，在伴有肝硬化背景的HCC中，环状RNA（circRNA）的调控尚未得到充分阐明。本研究采用高通量circRNA测序，以鉴定伴有肝硬化背景的HCC样本中的候选circRNA。在体外和体内环境中均验证了候选circRNA的生物学功能。此外，利用Alphafold 3、质谱分析和免疫荧光技术来探究其潜在机制。我们发现circCEP70在肝硬化HCC样本中表现出显著更高的表达水平，并与更好的预后呈正相关。RNA结合蛋白U2AF2被发现可抑制肝硬化患者中circCEP70的表达。体外和体内实验，包括CCK-8、EdU、平板克隆、transwell、划痕、皮下肿瘤形成、原位肝转移和肺转移实验，均证实了其抗癌作用。机制上，circCEP70编码一种名为CEP70-160aa的新蛋白，该蛋白与PKM2相互作用并阻碍其转位进入细胞核。这种相互作用导致细胞核中STAT3磷酸化减少，从而抑制HCC的增殖和转移。在肝硬化微环境中，circCEP70通过PKM2/STAT3轴阻止HCC的增殖和转移，而RNA结合蛋白U2AF2可抑制circCEP70的表达。
